calls.stdout:
usage: sample-app-server [-h] [--remote REMOTE]
                         {count-notes,create-note,delete-note,list-notes,search-notes}
                         ...

Remote client for sample_app

positional arguments:
  {count-notes,create-note,delete-note,list-notes,search-notes}
    count-notes         Return how many notes exist.
    create-note         Create a note with a title and an optional body;
                        returns the note.
    delete-note         Delete a note by id; returns True when a note was
                        removed.
    list-notes          List all notes, in creation order.
    search-notes        Find notes whose title or body contains the query
                        (case-insensitive).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --remote REMOTE       base URL of the clivane serve server

usage: sample-app-server count-notes [-h] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --json      structured JSON output

usage: sample-app-server create-note [-h] --title TITLE [--body BODY] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --title TITLE  str
  --body BODY    str
  --json         structured JSON output

usage: sample-app-server delete-note [-h] --note-id NOTE_ID [--json]

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --note-id NOTE_ID  int
  --json             structured JSON output

usage: sample-app-server list-notes [-h] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --json      structured JSON output

usage: sample-app-server search-notes [-h] --query QUERY [--json]

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --query QUERY  str
  --json         structured JSON output
